description: Hello #TeamCastro! Can you believe we are 41 days from the election??? Together, we have accomplished so much. All 15,000 postcards have been completed, and now we're in full swing with canvassing. Phone banking will start next week, with both virtual and in-person opportunities. Support and momentum continues to build! This weekend we canvassed with Shawn Harris on Saturday, and Micheal Garza and Chris Harden on Sunday. We knocked over 500 doors!! A HEFTY thank you to everyone who has donated funds, time, stamps and encouragement to this campaign. Volunteer support is the backbone of our outreach and success! Hope to see you at a campaign event soon! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
